packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 is the Go-native port and ships no stable programmatic compiler API (it lands in 7.1). typescript-eslint cannot parse with it, so type-aware linting breaks. Hold on 6.x until 7.1 and typescript-eslint support land.
Automerge GitHub Actions minor and patch updates. Scope is CI only, and a break fails loudly in the workflow run.
Automerge devDependency minor and patch updates. These never reach the production bundle, and lint/type-check/test cover them.
Automerge patch updates for runtime dependencies. Merging master deploys to production, so minors and majors stay manual.
Never automerge a major, regardless of dep type.
